Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, the effect reads "you may play it," so you may also choose to not play it. In such cases, you add it to your hand like any other card.
Card Q&A.q: When I reveal a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect, can I choose to not play that card?

a: It can't be played due to [BT9-047 Pomumon]'s effect, so you add it to your hand like any other card.
Card Q&A.q: I revealed a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect] when I had a [BT9-047 Pomumon]. What happens to that card?

Effect: [On Play] By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon that's black or has [Legend-Arms] in its traits as its bottom digivolution card, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a Digimon card with [Legend-Arms] in its traits and a play cost of 7 or less, you may play it without paying its memory cost. Add the rest to your hand.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have a Digimon that's black or has [Legend-Arms] in its traits in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
